description:
Lists the ReadingRate book clubs the reader belongs to, with their role in each and the book each club is reading now.

Use when the reader asks about their book clubs or what their clubs are reading. For one club's members and past books, use get_book_club; for its current book's schedule and discussion questions, use get_book_club_current_read.
name: list_book_clubs

club_count.description: Number of clubs the reader belongs to

clubs.description: The reader's clubs with their role and each club's current book

active_read.description: The book the club is reading now, or null

message.description: Human-readable note when the reader is in no club

title: List book clubs
